name: Wooden Horse Carving
description: A beautiful, hand-whittled horse. Kel would probably like this.

name: Lucky Coin
description: Though it should be impossible, flipping the coin shows either a Heart, Spade, Diamond or Club symbol, despite the coin only being two sided.

name: Goblin's Sleeping Bag
description: A comfy, but goblin-scented sleeping bag. Leto did say a sleeping bag would work...

name: Damp Flier
description: This seems to be an ad for some sort of bath house... but the paper is so damp that you can't make out anything. Maybe someone really wet could read it?

name: Slimy Bathrobe
description: Peeled off a Cloaked Quivering Blob. It's still moving a little, and it smells exactly like the fog over Greener Pastures. Wear it and the cultists might take you for one of their own.

name: Faint Ectoglue
description: A thin, barely-green smear. Whatever horse this came from didn't have much going on, spiritually.

name: Ectoglue
description: A faintly glowing green paste with a slow, steady pulse. Greener Pastures insists it's a "memorial keepsake." Sometimes, if you hold it to your ear, you can hear a faint whinny.

name: Potent Ectoglue
description: Thick, vividly green, and it moves when you aren't looking at it. Smells like a winner's circle and a craft store.

name: Ancient Ectoglue
description: Rendered from a horse so old it remembers the first race. The jar rattles at night. Something in there is still trying to finish.
